# Studio Faraj

> Web development studio in Padova (Veneto, Italy), founded in 2020. Studio Faraj designs and writes custom websites, e-commerce stores and business software (management systems, CRMs) for companies in Italy and abroad, then hosts, optimises and maintains them. No templates or page builders: every project is written to measure, and the client owns the source code, domain and content.

## Key facts

- Founder: Hussein Faraj, full-stack developer. He follows every project from the first meeting to launch, then hosting, technical SEO and maintenance: clients talk to the person who writes the code.
- Based in: Via Ludovico Ariosto 42, 35128 Padova (PD), Italy.
- Works with clients in: Italy, Switzerland, France, Belgium, Germany, the United Kingdom, the United States, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait and Lebanon.
- Languages: Italian and English. The site is in Italian with English versions; blog posts are in Italian.
- Contact: info@studiofaraj.it, phone and WhatsApp +39 320 222 3322. Hours: Monday to Friday 9:00–18:00, Saturday 10:00–14:00 (Italian time).
- Usually replies within 24 working hours. The first consultation is free.

## How to start a project

- [Start your project](https://studiofaraj.it/it/inizia): the ways to start, the stages a request goes through, what to prepare and FAQ (English: https://studiofaraj.it/en/inizia).
- Quote without an account: the "Richiedi un preventivo" form on any page, or [Contatti](https://studiofaraj.it/it/contatti).
- [Book a call](https://studiofaraj.it/it/call-booking) or write on WhatsApp.
- Client area (free account): send a request, receive the quote, pay it online through Stripe, chat with the studio, share files up to 25 MB, and follow the request through its stages (new, quote sent, accepted, in progress, delivered). Each change of status is also sent by email.

## Services

- [Custom websites](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi/sviluppo-web): company websites and web applications.
- [E-commerce](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi/e-commerce): complete online stores, from catalogue to payments, without third-party store platforms.
- [Business software](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi/software-gestionale): management systems and CRMs built around the client's process (jobs, clients, work progress).
- [UI/UX design](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi/design-ui-ux): interfaces designed for every device before any code is written.
- [SEO and web marketing](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi/seo-marketing): search visibility and measurable campaigns.
- [AI and automation](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi/ai-automazione): chatbots, analysis and automations inside the tools a business already uses.
- [Hosting and cloud](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi/hosting-cloud): managed hosting, SSL certificates and backups.
- [Maintenance](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi/manutenzione): plans that keep a site updated, secure and fast.
- [Consulting](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi/consulenza): support for strategic and technical decisions.
- [All services](https://studiofaraj.it/it/servizi)

## Technologies

- Interface: React, Next.js, Astro, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML, CSS
- Server: Node.js, .NET, Java, Scala, Python, PHP, REST APIs, GraphQL
- Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase
- Payments: Stripe, PayPal, Klarna
- Infrastructure: Vercel, Google Cloud, AWS, Docker
